About us:
Gismart is a value-driven mobile app developer with a strong presence in the Health & Wellness, Utilities, and Music app markets. We have recently achieved a significant milestone of over 1 billion downloads worldwide, taking a step toward our mission of cultivating the well-being of people worldwide. With headquarters in London, UK, Gismart is a dynamic global company with a reach extending across Europe and far beyond. Our determined team comprises over 250 individuals who bring diversity, creativity, innovation, and relentless drive to the company. Gismart unites professionals from diverse backgrounds in entertainment, music, and tech, allowing us to play to each other’s strengths and succeed as a team.
Our mission:
Become a stepping stone on our customers’ journeys of self-improvement.

Our values:
• 
Deliver what matters
• 
Respect and support others
• 
Initiate and own
• 
Voice openly
• 
Execute with quality
If you are passionate about mobile app development and want to join a company that’s reshaping the industry, Gismart is the place for you. We provide exciting career opportunities, a supportive workplace culture, and the chance to contribute to a team that is making a tangible impact. For more information on Gismart, visit gismart.com.

About project

At Radiotech, we believe music belongs to everyone — not just those who grew up taking lessons. As a product company inside the Gismart ecosystem, we’ve spent years building apps that make music feel approachable, fun, and deeply human. With 23 apps across iOS and Android and over 500 million downloads worldwide, our products have found their way into the hands of musicians, beginners, and curious souls across the globe. We see music as a universal language. Our job is to make sure more people can speak it.
The Creative Production Lead owns the strategic growth of the creative production function, translating company-level goals into team execution while building the people, processes, and cross-functional relationships needed to scale creative output. This role is a defined growth track toward Head of Creative Production, with scope expanding as the team and its impact on business metrics grow.

Responsibilities:
1. Strategy & Performance
• 
Decompose company OKRs into actionable creative team goals and KPIs
• 
Track OKR completion, creative output volume, and performance against targets
• 
Report on team performance and creative impact to leadership
2. People Management
• 
Full ownership of team management: hiring, onboarding, and performance reviews
• 
Design and run career development paths, including promotion criteria
• 
Build a team education program (skills growth, internal training, external learning)
• 
Manage team capacity planning and workload distribution
3. Cross-Functional Collaboration
• 
Build and maintain strong working relationships with Product, PMM, and UA teams
• 
Align creative priorities with product roadmaps and UA testing needs
• 
Represent creative production in cross-functional planning cycles
4. Process & Automation
• 
Identify and drive automation opportunities across the creative production pipeline (briefing, asset delivery, QA, reporting)
• 
Own tooling decisions and process documentation
• 
Continuously reduce time-to-launch for creative assets
5. Team Culture & Knowledge Sharing
• 
Establish and run team rituals (standups, retros, creative reviews)
• 
Drive in-house knowledge sharing (playbooks, best-practice libraries, post-mortems)
• 
Foster a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement

Experience:
• 
4+ years in creative production, creative strategy, or performance creative roles, with at least 1-2 years in a team lead or management capacity
• 
Proven track record producing creative for performance marketing channels (Meta, AppLovin, TikTok, or similar)
• 
Experience with mobile app or gaming creative production is a strong plus; familiarity with playable ads (e.g. Cocos Creator or similar engines) is a bonus
• 
Experience managing creative production budgets and resourcing (in-house team, freelancers, or agencies)

Mindset:
• 
Systems thinker — genuinely energized by building process and automation, not just managing output
• 
Growth-oriented, with clear interest in scaling into a Head of Creative Production role
• 
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, iteration-heavy environment (multiple products, frequent creative testing cycles)

Employee Benefits:
• 
Remote-First Culture: Our team is diverse and extensive, just like our product portfolio. We provide a flexible working schedule and let you work anywhere in the world, either remotely or in one of our corporate hubs
• 
Сoworking Compensation: We provide 100% compensation for coworking spaces in Ukraine (except Kyiv, where we have a cozy and autonomous hub) and 50% compensation for coworking spaces worldwide to make sure that everyone has a comfortable and inspiring workspace
• 
Free Office Lunches: We want you to stay fueled and focused, so we provide delicious free lunches for everyone working from our hubs. It’s one less thing for you to worry about during a productive workday
• 
Public Holidays Policy: Gismart observes public holidays based on the Ukrainian or Polish holiday calendars. Employees working in other locations are entitled to 12 public holidays per year
• 
100% Sick Leave Compensation
• 
Mental and Physical Health: To help you stay happy and healthy, Gismart will partially cover your medical insurance, sports activities, therapy costs
• 
Personal Equipment Policy: Of course, we’ll provide you with all the equipment you need or cover the maintenance cost for your own tools
• 
Personal Learning and Development: We love to see you learn and grow, so Gismart will cover 70% of your professional development courses. We’ll also pay for 100% of corporate English courses
• 
Time-Off Policy: Every employee gets 18 working days of paid vacation and 3 personal days per year, with an extra day added for each year at Gismart
• 
Corporate Events: We are remote-first, but we love meeting up in person. Whenever possible, we organize corporate events and team-building activities across all Gismart hubs

Role Overview We are seeking a highly technical Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of digital products within CTI-MD. This role is ideal for a product professional who combines strong product management fundamentals with hands-on technical expertise and can effectively bridge business, engineering, data, and operations teams. The successful candidate will own products from discovery through delivery and adoption, partnering closely with scientists, business stakeholders, engineers, architects, data teams, and quality teams to solve complex business challenges within the pharmaceutical and life sciences domain. This is a hands-on role. While the primary responsibility is product leadership, the individual should be comfortable reading code, writing prototypes, analysing data, developing proof-of-concepts, and contributing technically when necessary. What You Will Do Product Strategy & Ownership - Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for a small to medium product, or for a major component of a larger CTI-MD product. - Partner with business stakeholders to understand challenges, opportunities, and unmet needs. - Translate business objectives into clear product strategies, measurable outcomes, and prioritized roadmaps. - Define and track product success metrics and business value realized, demonstrating measurable improvement in key departmental KPIs. - Identify market and industry opportunities that inform product direction and business unit goals. Product Discovery - Lead discovery activities including user research, workflow analysis, process mapping, and solution evaluation. - Develop deep understanding of business processes and operational workflows. - Validate assumptions through experimentation, data analysis, prototypes, and user feedback. Technical Product Leadership - Work closely with engineering teams to shape technical solutions and architecture decisions. - Translate business requirements into detailed product and technical requirements. - Evaluate technology options, architectural trade-offs, integrations, scalability, and technical risks. - Drive data-driven, and platform-thinking approaches. Delivery & Execution - Partner with engineering teams through design, development, testing, deployment, and support. - Manage product backlogs and prioritization decisions. - Balance customer needs, business priorities, compliance requirements, and technical constraints. - Ensure products are delivered with quality, security, and operational excellence. AI & Digital Innovation - Identify opportunities for AI, automation, analytics, and digital technologies within CTI-MD products. - Drive adoption of modern engineering and AI-enabled product development practices. - Evaluate emerging technologies and their potential application to business challenges.
